question: As per the 2ⁿd Advance Estimate of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, the record foodgrains production of _______ million tonnes is estimated in India in the year 2021-22.
solution:
The correct answer is __**316.06**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The record foodgrains production in India for the year 2021-22 was estimated at 316.06 million tonnes.
 
• This estimation was based on the 2nd Advance Estimate provided by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.
 
• The 2nd Advance Estimate is one of the several periodic assessments conducted to gauge agricultural productivity.
 
• Foodgrains include cereals, pulses, and other crops that constitute the staple diet in India.
 
• The record production is indicative of favorable agricultural policies and good monsoon conditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare**

 
 
• This ministry is responsible for the formulation and implementation of national policies and programs aimed at achieving rapid agricultural growth.
 
• It works towards increasing the income of farmers and improving rural livelihoods.
 
 
 
• **Advance Estimates**
 
 
• Advance Estimates are released at different times during the agricultural year to provide timely information on crop production.
 
• They help in planning and policy-making by providing early indications of agricultural output.
 
 
 
• **Foodgrain Categories**
 
 
• Foodgrains are primarily divided into cereals (like rice, wheat, and maize) and pulses (like lentils, chickpeas, and beans).
 
• These are essential for food security and nutrition in India.
